div.head: EGu 11
div.ab: Gyf wycan oððe wigleras, mansworan oððe morðwyrhtan oððe fule, afylede, æbære horcwenan ahwar on lande wurðan agytene, ðonne fyse hi man of earde ⁊ clænsie þa ðeode, oððon on earde forfare hy mid ealle, buton hig geswican ⁊ ðe deoppor gebetan.

Gif wiccan oððe wigleras, mansworan oððe morðwyrhtan oððe fule, afylede, æbære horcwenan ahwar on lande wurðan agytene, ðonne fyse hi man of earde ⁊ clænsie þa ðeode, oððe on earde forfare hy mid ealle, buton hig geswican ⁊ þe deoppor gebetan.

Si wyce uel wigleres, mansporan et morðwirthan ⁊ fule, afylede, abere horcpenan alicubi sint in terra inuente, educantur de patria, et emundetur populus, uel in patria dispereant omnino, nisi cessent et profundius emendent.

[Be wicum, wiglerum, mansworum etc.] [Ld] Gif wiccan oðð wigleras, mansworan oððe morðwyrhtan oððe fule, afylede, æbere horcwenan ahwar on lande wurðan agytene, ðonne fyse hi man of earde ⁊ clænsie þa ðeode, oððe on earde forfare hy mid ealle, buton hig geswican ⁊ þe deoppor gebetan.

If wizards or sorcerers, perjurers or they who secretly encompass death, or vile, polluted, notorious prostitutes be met with anywhere in the country, they shall be driven from the land and the nation shall be purified; otherwise they shall be utterly destroyed in the land—unless they cease from their wickedness and make amends to the utmost of their ability.

(Von Zauberern, Wahrsagern, Meineidigen etc. Ld) Wenn Zauberer oder Wahrsager, Meineidige oder heimliche Mordstifter oder schmutzige, verderbte, offenbare Hurenweiber irgendwo im Lande betroffen werden, dann jage man sie ausser Landes und säubere das Volk, oder man vernichte sie gänzlich im Lande, es sei denn, sie lassen [vom Bösen] ab und büssen um so tiefer.

(Of sorcerers, soothsayers, perjurers, etc. Ld) If sorcerers or soothsayers, perjurers or secret murderers, or filthy, corrupt, notorious whores are found anywhere in the land, then let them be driven out of the country and the people cleansed, or let them be destroyed utterly in the land, unless they desist [from evil] and make all the deeper amends.
